title: CL-BENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR CONTEXT LEARNING
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (CL-bench) to evaluate how well LLMs learn from provided context (new domain-specific knowledge, rule systems, etc.). While it includes 'Humanities' and 'Legal Advisory' categories, the tasks focus on technical information retrieval and rule application from the provided text. In fact, system prompts for these tasks explicitly instruct the models to avoid external ethical, political, or religious knowledge.
